displayName.text: Instructions for the safe use of the product

value.value: Wash before first wear. Not intended to be chewed or eaten. Keep away from open flames.
Remove the neck label and the care label by cutting the stitching. No other non-textile components are present.
Pass on to family or friends, or donate via textile collection or second-hand shops if the garment is still wearable.
Hand over to a separate textile collection for fibre-to-fibre recycling of cotton.
Do not dispose of in residual waste. Use separate textile collection points as required in the EU from 2025.
